evidence: GATE DIMENSIONS CARRY THE REAL GATE. (1) gates/render/judge.toml lines 20-34 contain authenticated_render, with all_pass aggregation. It checks reachability and a real matter chat, not a blank/static/error page. It also checks that nothing private shows before sign-in, matching instruction.md line 7, that a wrong password is rejected and that gwen/password123 opens her matters and messages. It says 'Assign 1 only if every check holds'. (2) gates/constraints/judge.toml lines 20-37 contain server_backed_local_application. It requires a real server write and reload as Gwen, then a readback of 'Gate check JUDGE-G1' by harriet in a separate browser context. That excludes localStorage-only and static-facade apps, which REVIEW_POLICY requires: 'Gates must exclude convincing dead apps'. It says explicitly that external font/script/CDN requests are allowed under the public posture. It does not require same-origin. 'Reached from the local server at http://localhost:3000' is only the mandated serving address (integration.md line 1). (3) scoring.toml has render and constraints gates at 0.0. score.py lines 40-48 pass a gate only when its score is > 0, and otherwise force every scored dimension and the reward to 0. test.sh lines 212-219 skip the scored suite when the gates fail. test.sh, score.py and scoring.toml are byte-identical to the frozen template (diff clean). FEASIBILITY OF THE CONSTRAINTS GATE ON A CONFORMING APP. walls-and-retention.md says 'Anyone who can see a matter can post and reply in it' and 'Our staff see every matter except the ones they are walled from'. Seed M-11 is Gwen's matter with walled [] and a 7-day timer. A new message is age 0 on the fixed clock, so it is not deleted. A conforming app therefore cannot legitimately fail the gate. The probe is absent from the seed. EVERY SCORED PROMPT RESTATES THE IN-DIMENSION GATE. functional/prompt.md lines 11-19, polish/prompt.md lines 10-18 and visual/prompt.md lines 18-26 have the same block: the app loads at localhost:3000 with no fatal error; if it has sign-in, gwen can sign in and see protected content appropriate to the current state (auth leg); CDN requests are allowed; a blank page, empty workspace, static mock/shell, missing backend or seeded-looking facade fails; protected content must be real data backed by the running local server (backing leg); 'If the gate fails, assign 0 to every criterion in this dimension'. Each block zeros the whole dimension; none gives partial credit. Polish line 25 and visual line 43 call the gate 'the only all-or-nothing rule'. Functional runs in individual mode with one criterion per session, so each session re-applies the gate and zeros its own criterion, which is consistent. 'Current state' wording and the 'do not assume seed' notes (functional lines 72-78, polish line 32) mean later mutations do not falsely trip the gate. Gwen is a client and is never walled, and M-11 keeps held messages K-2/K-17, so her workspace never becomes empty. No gate text requires same-origin. The only 'origin' mention, functional line 42, describes how forged replays are sent, not a gate condition. COUNTEREXAMPLE SEARCH. (a) Broken app that might pass: a localStorage chat survives the reload but fails the Harriet separate-context readback. A static shell with canned JSON fails the write. An app that stores data only in server memory passes the gate but fails functional's restart-persistence criterion, which is the right owner of that requirement. (b) Conforming app that might fail: one loading Google Fonts or a CDN framework is explicitly allowed in all five prompts. A different API origin is not plausible because the brief mandates serving on port 3000. I found no credible counterexample. RUNTIME EVIDENCE (why risk=true). Scripted golden check gate_constraints PASS: golden-run.log line 2, functional.cjs lines 99-106, hashes match raw-evidence-index, and the source hashes (server.js 03b526..., app.js 8fc558...) match the frozen task. This is scripted Playwright only. There is no configured-judge run of the render or constraints gates on the golden app. There is no measured gate run on weak apps (blank, static shell, localStorage facade) showing the gates actually zero them. The raw-evidence-index scope says discrimination and full grading are absent. That required runtime evidence is missing, so risk stays true even though the source/prompt structure passes.
